name: Check engine
meaning: The engine computer logged a fault. Steady usually means a sensor or emissions issue. If it flashes, the engine is misfiring — slow down and call us.

name: Oil pressure
meaning: The engine isn't getting oil. Shut it off as soon as it's safe — a few more miles can end the engine. Check the level, then have it towed.

name: Brake system
meaning: Low brake fluid or a hydraulic fault, if the parking brake is off. Your stopping distance may already be longer than you think.

name: Battery / charging
meaning: The alternator isn't charging. The car runs on battery alone until it dies — usually within the hour. Skip the A/C and come straight here.

name: Engine temperature
meaning: The engine is overheating. Pull over, shut it off, and let it cool. Never open a hot radiator cap.

name: Tire pressure
meaning: One or more tires is 25% or more under pressure. Fill them to the number on the door jamb; if it comes back, you likely have a slow leak we can patch.
